# Phase Two — Critique and Twenty Improvements

The Awtsmoos breaks the easy answer before the easy answer breaks the page;
Awtsmoos.com turns each critique into a smaller, truer, testable stage.

1. Verify public JS bytes, not merely local disk presence.
2. Compare local loader hash to public loader hash.
3. Find whether `app.js` has a cache-busting version.
4. Verify CSS import version chains on mobile-series modules.
5. Make Groupings state contract test assert synthetic Chitas survives filtering.
6. Make result-count contract assert one grouping at Ikar root.
7. Keep synthetic groupings immutable and free from owner controls.
8. Render discovery by active view rather than branch data alone.
9. Do not show Nearby Branches beneath a Groupings empty state.
10. Keep Related/Explore available in Tree/Series view where it is semantically useful.
11. Ensure view changes repaint context discovery, not only content grids.
12. Prevent Advanced from fixed positioning at mobile widths.
13. Keep Advanced collapsed by default and avoid automatic open behavior.
14. Preserve desktop fixed utility behavior only if it does not obscure content.
15. Reserve mobile bottom-nav clearance in the main stage.
16. Avoid stacking two fixed elements above the same bottom inset.
17. Reduce root profile vertical footprint without deleting identity.
18. Avoid giant empty-state minimum heights on small screens.
19. Test at 360px, 390px, 430px widths with static CSS contracts.
20. Preserve all pre-existing unrelated work and rewrite only whole owned files.

## Revised direction

The primary bug is not "make cards prettier." It is state/composition coherence. The repair should prioritize semantic visibility and non-overlap first, then density.
